# Universal_Computation_Landscape

**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
The mapping of computational capabilities across different network topologies and dynamical states, identifying regions where arbitrary functions can be implemented. Guides topology selection and reconfiguration in TCC to ensure that interconnect structures support general-purpose computation rather than task-specific processing.
